target_buyer.organization: Ashtabula County Data Board / IT Services
target_buyer.why_top_candidate: Primary technology decision-maker for Ashtabula County. The Data Board oversees all IT purchases, software, and services for county offices per Ohio Revised Code 307.84. Recent procurements include $75K for Citizenserve building software and court computer upgrades. Manages IT infrastructure for 25+ county departments. No county office can purchase IT equipment or services without board approval.

actual_brand_research.existing_brand_name: Ashtabula County Data Board / IT Services
actual_brand_research.governance: Board consists of county treasurer, recorder, clerk of courts, board of commissioners representative, board of elections representatives, and county auditor (secretary)
actual_brand_research.authority_scope: All county offices must obtain prior approval for purchasing, leasing, operating, or contracting for data processing equipment, software, or services

brandkit_for_mvp.positioning: The GovTech platform for Ashtabula County Data Board — streamlining technology procurement, software deployment, and IT service management across 25+ county departments.
